project_type: Python FastAPI AI backend + PHP frontend, hackathon project (LangkahKampus - SNBP prediction)
build_system: pip for Python, Docker Compose for full stack
test_framework: pytest with TestClient (FastAPI), tests in ai_backend/tests/
verification_instructions: Run pytest in ai_backend directory, verify all tests pass including new ones
setup_instructions: pip install -r ai_backend/requirements.txt (already installed in sandbox)
environment_constraints: matplotlib and seaborn installed. No Docker daemon available. No Fireworks API key. ROCm not available (scripts should detect and handle gracefully). Network can fetch pip packages.
contribution_requirements: Branch: feat/ai-backend-integration. All code should work without external API keys (fallback behavior).
key_patterns: FastAPI endpoints in app/main.py, services in app/services/, schemas in app/schemas/, training scripts in training/. PHP pages in website/pages/, PHP APIs proxy to Python backend via website/api/. Tests use pytest fixtures with TestClient.
directory_structure: ai_backend/ (FastAPI app with ML model), website/ (PHP frontend), database/ (SQL schemas), docker-compose.yml (orchestration), demo/ (to be created)
